name: vnni
comment: DRAFT native-tree component for the VEX AVX-VNNI libz patch. NOT installed into inject/native/components by this step (that file set belongs to wave 4 / the pipeline). build_esp.py should run patcher/vnni_patch.py on the slot it is building (libz.so + build.prop of system and vendor in the in-root) with --odm-root and --out-rc, and emit this component ONLY with the files and rc that run produced (see INTEGRATION.md). The src paths below are the patched copies for build CL3B.260622.276.R4 / 16658739, and rc_files points at the rc generated for exactly that build: every bind in it is gated on ro.system.build.fingerprint / ro.vendor.build.fingerprint, because gb_slotsync reuses the same initrd (and so this /odm tree and rc) for an A/B OTA'd slot holding a different build. Never replace it with an ungated 'on early-init' bind.
